name: Шершень
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon HORNET character, bulky striped orange-black body, big translucent wings, fierce mandibles, bold fearless eyes.
motif: siege and warhorns, molten-orange armor plating and buzzing shockwaves
scenes: a young hornet clinging to a paper-nest edge, wings half-open, warm daylight.
a nest guard with a straw-armor collar and a tiny horn, hovering on patrol, side view.
an apprentice of sound magic, cyan buzz-rings pulsing from its wings, night nest glow.
a violet rune-knight in purple chitin plate with a rune lance, diving attack angle.
a legendary siege-commander, orange energy trails, leading a swarm against a burning sky.
the hornet ASCENDED into a golden WAR-GOD of the swarm, colossal golden armor, wings of gold foil, a crown of golden nest-combs, hovering above a golden hive-fortress.

name: Жужелица
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon GROUND BEETLE character, sleek iridescent violet-black shell, strong legs, sharp jaws, cool confident stare.
motif: night-hunter stealth, iridescent oil-slick sheen and violet blade-light
scenes: a small ground beetle scurrying across a mossy stone, shell catching a highlight.
a night tracker with a tiny lantern strapped to its back and leaf-cloak, in dark leaf litter.
an apprentice of shadow magic, cyan glyphs glowing along the shell seams, forest floor at night.
a violet rune-assassin with purple energy mandible-blades, mid-lunge, sparks on leaves.
a legendary shadow-reaper, orange fire eyes, cutting through a wall of darkness, dramatic.
the beetle ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF THE NIGHT FLOOR, colossal gilded shell like a mirror, golden blades, standing on a throne of golden leaf litter, awe-inspiring.

name: Жук-усач
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon LONGHORN BEETLE character, elongated glossy body with speckled elytra, extremely long striped antennae, curious noble face.
motif: conductor's antennae, teal resonance waves and wood-grain runes
scenes: a longhorn beetle on a fresh log, antennae sweeping, bright sunny forest.
a timber surveyor with a measuring cord and a tiny hard hat, standing on a cut stump.
an apprentice of resonance magic, cyan waves rippling from its antennae, night woodpile.
a violet rune-conductor waving antennae like batons, purple rune-notes orbiting, dramatic.
a legendary wood-shaper, orange energy carving a colossal tree into glowing shapes.
the beetle ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF THE ANCIENT WOOD, colossal golden antennae arcing like bridges, gilded log-throne, rings of golden grain glowing, majestic.

name: Жук-златка
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon JEWEL BEETLE character, dazzling metallic emerald-and-copper iridescent shell, compact body, vain sparkling eyes.
motif: living jewelry, prismatic rainbow refraction and gemstone facets
scenes: a small jewel beetle on a sunlit leaf, shell throwing rainbow highlights.
a gem courier with a tiny gem-case and a monocle, standing on a jewel-strewn bark.
an apprentice of light magic, cyan prisms splitting a beam around it, night crystal cave.
a violet rune-jeweler setting glowing purple gems into a floating rune ring, sparks.
a legendary prism-lord, orange refracted beams shooting across a mirrored cavern, radiant.
the beetle ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF GEMS, shell of faceted solid gold and diamonds, seated on a mountain of gemstones, rainbow godrays, dazzling.

name: Медведка
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon MOLE CRICKET character, stocky brown velvety body with huge shovel-like front claws, goofy-tough face.
motif: underground digging power, earth-brown tunnels and amber soil light
scenes: a mole cricket half-emerged from a soil tunnel, claws braced, garden bed at dawn.
a tunnel digger with a miner's lamp on its head and a rope belt, in a dirt shaft.
an apprentice of earth magic, cyan runes glowing on its claws, underground crystal roots.
a violet rune-driller with purple energy shovel-claws boring through rock, debris flying.
a legendary tunnel-breaker, orange lava cracks in the walls, bursting up through the ground.
the mole cricket ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF THE UNDERGROUND, colossal golden claws, a cathedral of gilded tunnels and roots behind, standing in a beam of surface light.

name: Клоп-солдатик
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon FIREBUG (soldier bug) character, flat oval body with bold red-and-black mask pattern, tiny brave soldier face.
motif: parade discipline and heraldry, scarlet-black banners and shield patterns
scenes: a small firebug on a warm tree trunk in a row with pattern-mates, sunny spring day.
a squad recruit with a tiny wooden shield and a red sash, standing at attention on bark.
an apprentice of ward magic, cyan shield-runes forming a small barrier, night bark.
a violet rune-legionary in purple lacquered shell armor, shield wall formation, sparks.
a legendary standard-bearer, orange banner blazing, leading a colossal formation, epic.
the firebug ASCENDED into a golden WAR-MARSHAL god, colossal golden shell heraldry, a banner of gold silk, standing on a golden bark-fortress, army of light below.

name: Дождевой червь
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon EARTHWORM character, glossy segmented pink-brown body, simple sweet face at the front end, expressive posture curls.
motif: soil alchemy and rain, warm coral-pink with rich humus-gold sparkle
scenes: a small earthworm poking out of dark soil after rain, droplets around, dawn light.
a soil gardener with a tiny straw hat and a leaf shovel, tilling a garden bed.
an apprentice of earth magic, cyan roots glowing around it in cutaway soil, night.
a violet rune-weaver knitting purple glowing root-runes through the earth, dramatic cutaway.
a legendary life-tiller, orange energy turning barren dirt into blazing fertile ground.
the earthworm ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF THE SOIL, colossal golden coils spiraling through a cutaway of gilded earth, roots of light, seeds sprouting gold, majestic.

name: Сороконожка
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon CENTIPEDE character, long segmented amber-orange body with many legs, big friendly-but-fierce eyes, expressive S-curve pose.
motif: rippling wave of legs, neon-amber ripple light and rhythmic motion trails
scenes: a small centipede rippling over a wet stone, legs in a wave, damp forest floor.
a litter runner with a woven band and a tiny satchel per segment, dashing over roots.
an apprentice of motion magic, cyan ripple rings following each leg, night cave.
a violet rune-serpentine in purple segmented armor, coiling into a rune spiral, glowing.
a legendary ripple-storm, orange energy waves rolling down a colossal body, dramatic.
the centipede ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF ENDLESS MOTION, colossal golden segments spiraling like a helix, hundreds of golden legs of light, cosmic gilded cave.

name: Шелкопряд
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon SILK MOTH character, plush cream-white furry body, big feathery antennae, soft wide wings, gentle dreamy eyes.
motif: woven silk threads and moonlight, pearl-white with iridescent shimmer
scenes: a small silk moth resting on a mulberry leaf, wings folded, soft evening light.
a silk weaver with a spindle and a thread-spool belt, sitting on a cocoon, workshop mood.
an apprentice of thread magic, cyan silk lines weaving a glowing rune-net, moonlit night.
a violet rune-weaver suspended in a purple web of glowing threads, arms spread, dramatic.
a legendary loom-master, orange threads of fire weaving a colossal tapestry in the sky.
the silk moth ASCENDED into a golden GOD OF THE LOOM, wings of woven gold silk, colossal tapestry of gold threads forming constellations, floating serenely, transcendent.
